name: band narrow grip high row v. 2
description: A second variation of the narrow grip high row using a band. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Anchor the band high and grip it with hands close together.
Step back to create tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
